claim_text: Human inter-annotator boundary discrepancy noise floor is 10-16 ms (20 ms annotator ceiling)
reason: Literature-grounded psychoacoustic standard: Raymond et al. (2002), McAuliffe et al. (2017)
evidence_or_target: Target ceiling: Acc@20ms evaluates whether automatic alignment reaches human expert transcriber noise floor

claim_text: Montreal Forced Aligner triphone GMM-HMM acoustic models operate at 10 ms hop rate with sub-frame resolution
reason: Kaldi / MFA acoustic modeling specifications (McAuliffe et al., Interspeech 2017)
evidence_or_target: Architectural basis for achieving sub-20ms phonetic alignment

claim_text: MMS_FA (Wav2Vec2) CTC Trellis features a 20 ms convolutional frame stride
reason: Wav2Vec2 downsampling architecture: 16000 Hz / 320 hop = 50 Hz = 20.0 ms per frame
evidence_or_target: Architectural explanation for CTC discretization limits
